title: Busulfan (high-dose IV conditioning)
effect: Seizures with high-dose busulfan; 1/42 seized despite phenytoin prophylaxis, 36 h after the last dose (§5.2)
pearls: Label requires ASM prophylaxis: start 12 h before the first dose and continue to 24 h after the last (§2.1)
Label options: benzodiazepines, phenytoin, valproic acid or levetiracetam (§2.1, §5.2)
Phenytoin ↑ busulfan clearance ≥15%; label PK was studied on phenytoin, so exposure may be higher without it (§7.2)
Use caution with prior seizures, head trauma or other epileptogenic drugs (§5.2)
sources: Busulfex (busulfan) injection US prescribing information. Otsuka; revised 10/2026 (user-supplied label)
